messages:
maya: Quick check — our biweekly release window this cycle overlaps with the week of holidays for APAC. Can we move the branch cutoff earlier so teams in APAC aren't on-call for merges? :wave:

sam: +1. I noticed a couple of version-bump PRs still open. If we move cutoff 48h earlier that should give reviewers time. Current cutoff is `Fri 18:00 UTC`. Proposing `Wed 18:00 UTC`.

jordan: That sounds reasonable. Heads-up: the infra team needs a day for smoke tests after the branch cut — can we keep an automated canary on Wed->Thu?

alex: I can add a calendar update. Would prefer `Wed 15:00 UTC` to give timezone buffer. Also adding a 48h and 12h reminder to the release calendar event. I’ll update the shared event unless anyone objects.

maya: No objections from me. Sam/Jordan — can you confirm there are no critical rollouts that require the original Fri window?

sam: Quick check: only `pkg/telemetry` and `cli` have pending PRs that tag the release. I'll ping owners now for final reviews.

jordan: From infra side, nothing blocking. We'll accept Wed 15:00 UTC as long as the canary job goes green.

release-bot: Automated notice — scheduled release window change detected. Old cutoff: `Fri 18:00 UTC`. New cutoff: `Wed 15:00 UTC`. Reminders: `T-48h`, `T-12h`. Canary job: `release-canary-v2`.

maya: Thanks bot. Sam — can you paste the quick command snippet you use for the cutoff so docs/ops owners can follow?

sam: Sure — here's the branch cut script we run:```bash
# run from repo root
git checkout -b release/$RELEASE_VERSION
./scripts/merge-ready.sh --from=main --to=release/$RELEASE_VERSION
./scripts/publish-changelog.sh --release=$RELEASE_VERSION
```

sam: Also adding a short changelog nudge to the `#changelogs` channel for package owners to update entries.

alex: Calendar updated and invite sent to `@eng` and `@release-approvers`. I also toggled the 48h/12h reminders.

maya: Awesome. Two quick asks before we close: 1) Sam, ping the PR owners for last reviews. 2) Jordan, ensure the canary has an alternate fallback if it fails (auto-rollback).

jordan: Will do. I'll add an auto-fallback policy: if `release-canary-v2` fails 3 consecutive runs we rollback and re-open the cutoff for emergency fixes.

sam: Pinging owners now: @lina (pkg/telemetry), @devin (cli). Please merge or comment by Tue EOD UTC.

lina: (quick reply in-thread) noted — I'll get telemetry PR green by Tue.

devin: (quick reply) cli PR needs a small test tweak, will ship today.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll mark the release plan change in the release playbook and close this thread once the canary job passes tomorrow. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Canary job queued: `release-canary-v2` — queued by @jordan — expected run: `Wed 16:00 UTC`.
